take.title: The Wall and the Takes
take.bookTitle: The making of the LEGO Odyssey

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: The player. Every set, every figure, every brick of geometry, packed in one file. Ninety megabytes.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Ninety-five. A bigger player is refused, and the host takes no file over a hundred.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: So it is split. Each location's geometry goes beside the player, in a file of its own, fetched when the scene loads.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: The player is six megabytes now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: The raft is shot again, and the new take is better. I'll put it over the old one.

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: Keep every take. I want to see how it got there.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Then nothing is overwritten. The old take goes on the shelf, with a note of what the next one changed, and why.

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: Sixteen scenes shot again. Thirty-three takes.
